note: Conceptual/architecture lesson on master-detail vs. lookup tradeoffs. No screenshots per this course's policy: taught through prose, tables, and a written scenario, never UI click-paths. All specific behavior claims were verified directly against official Salesforce documentation: cascade delete, the detail record's unavailable Owner field and inherited sharing, the required relationship field on the detail layout, default no-reparenting with an explicit admin-controlled override, and roll-up summary fields working only on the master side of a master-detail relationship. No exact numeric cap on relationships per object is stated, since multiple third-party sources disagreed on the figure and it could not be confirmed on an official developer.salesforce.com or help.salesforce.com page during this pass.
